description: Minimal site studio kit. The complete small-website build methodology: intake with the one-thing test, seven bundled writing styles, six curated layout patterns with the shared design system, the AI-tell copy scrub, the optional privacy-first build flavor, and the pre-ship checklist, for building plain HTML and CSS one-pagers and small static sites that load in one request. One call returns the full kit; the buyer's agent builds the site itself. Price: $12.00 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

brief.description: Optional site brief that seeds the intake step, e.g. a one-pager for a candle maker.
